sar.narrative: This report details suspected coordinated fraud involving card C13487-K1 and 21 connected cards. Between November 15, 2016, and November 22, 2016, two online transactions totaling $187.33 were made on card C13487-K1 in region 191. These purchases were conducted using a Samsung SM-G935F device profile (ID D004630) operating behind an anonymous proxy. This device was recorded as new to the account. Graph analysis revealed that the same device profile and proxy setup was used across 21 other cards during the past month. Furthermore, this specific device is the linking node for a known fraud ring (36700632) and is directly connected to multiple prior confirmed fraud cases. The activity is highly suspicious as it demonstrates a coordinated pattern of abuse across multiple unrelated accounts using a single device setup, fitting an undocumented fraud typology. The total exposure on the primary card is $187.33.
